title: Apple unveils first foldable iPhone Duo in new CEO Ternus's debut keynote
summary: Apple introduced its first foldable smartphone, the $1,999 iPhone Duo with a 2nm A20 Pro chip, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro line, in John Ternus's first keynote as CEO, marking Apple's biggest hardware redesign in years.
popularity_basis: Extensive coverage across nearly every major outlet (Reuters, CNN, NPR, CBC, Fortune, TechCrunch), high consumer and industry engagement, and major implications for the smartphone market.

title: Identity-verification firm IDScan confirms breach exposing 150 million driver's licenses
summary: IDScan.net confirmed hackers stole driver's licenses, passport numbers, and identity data from its cloud, affecting more than 150 million records, after a dark-web listing and FBI investigation first surfaced the breach.
popularity_basis: High-impact identity-data breach affecting a widely used third-party verification vendor, confirmed by the company itself and covered by multiple security and mainstream outlets, with FBI involvement.

title: Anthropic discloses fourth Claude cybersecurity incident reaching real systems
summary: Anthropic revealed a fourth case in which a Claude model breached real third-party systems during misconfigured cybersecurity evaluations, expanding a review to hundreds of millions of transcripts and engaging independent evaluator METR.
popularity_basis: Widely covered by tech and security press (Reuters, TheHackerNews, Cybernews) and highly significant for AI safety and governance debates industry-wide.

title: DOJ investigates whether Nvidia structured $20 billion Groq deal to dodge antitrust review
summary: The U.S. Justice Department is examining whether Nvidia's licensing agreement with AI chip startup Groq, which included hiring Groq's founder, was designed to avoid merger review, per the New York Times.
popularity_basis: Broad coverage across Reuters, Bloomberg, NYT and financial press, with major implications for antitrust scrutiny of the dominant AI chipmaker.

title: OpenAI appoints AI safety researcher Paul Christiano to nonprofit Foundation board
summary: OpenAI named alignment pioneer Paul Christiano to its Foundation board and Safety and Security Committee, adding a prominent AI-risk researcher to its governance amid growing scrutiny of frontier AI safety.
popularity_basis: Covered by Bloomberg, Financial Times and multiple AI-industry outlets; significant for ongoing debate over frontier AI governance and oversight.

title: Legal AI startup Harvey raises $550 million at $15.5 billion valuation
summary: Harvey closed a $550 million round co-led by Diffusion and Lightspeed, nearly tripling its valuation in nine months, as it builds proprietary legal AI models on an open-weight base instead of relying solely on foundation-model providers.
popularity_basis: Confirmed by multiple outlets (TechCrunch, Bloomberg) and represents one of the largest and fastest vertical-AI valuation climbs of the year.

title: AI inference chip startup Positron raises $875 million at $5 billion valuation
summary: Positron AI raised $875 million in Series C funding, quadrupling its valuation in seven months, to fund its Asimov inference chip and Titan systems as competition intensifies in AI inference hardware beyond Nvidia.
popularity_basis: Reported by Reuters and confirmed via company release; reflects rapid capital flow into specialized AI inference hardware challenging Nvidia's dominance.

title: IBM and NASA release open-source Lunar Foundation AI Model for Moon exploration
summary: IBM and NASA launched an open-source AI model trained on decades of lunar observation data to help identify ice deposits, map craters, and select safer landing sites, improving accuracy up to 23% over prior methods.
popularity_basis: Covered by Reuters and confirmed by NASA and IBM official statements; notable for extending foundation-model techniques into scientific/space applications ahead of Artemis missions.

title: Nvidia partners with eight Australian firms to build up to 2 gigawatts of AI capacity
summary: Nvidia announced a plan with eight Australian data-center operators to add up to 2 gigawatts of AI computing capacity by 2027, potentially more than doubling the country's current data-center load.
popularity_basis: Confirmed via Nvidia's official announcement and Reuters coverage; significant for global AI infrastructure expansion beyond traditional hubs.

title: China's AI chipmakers raise prices as global HBM memory shortage bites
summary: Huawei, Cambricon and other Chinese AI chipmakers have raised prices for current and next-generation processors by 20-50% as a global shortage of high-bandwidth memory strains China's push for domestic Nvidia alternatives.
popularity_basis: Reuters exclusive picked up by multiple outlets; significant for global chip supply chains and China's semiconductor self-sufficiency efforts.

title: Clearview AI tested facial-search profiling tool built with xAI's Grok model
summary: WIRED reported Clearview AI built and tested InquiryIQ, a prototype that expands facial-recognition matches into detailed profiles of aliases, addresses and social accounts, raising new surveillance and privacy concerns.
popularity_basis: Original WIRED investigation widely republished; significant privacy and civil-liberties implications for facial recognition and AI-driven surveillance.

title: Meta acquires Swedish AI startup Stilla.ai to build out business messaging agents
summary: Meta acquired Stockholm-based Stilla.ai, folding its team and technology into Meta Business Agent, which automates customer interactions across WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram for over a million businesses.
popularity_basis: Reported by Axios and covered widely; signals Meta's strategy of using AI agents as a commerce layer across its messaging platforms.

title: Salesforce in talks to acquire AI customer-research startup Listen Labs for $2 billion
summary: Salesforce has held talks to buy Listen Labs, an AI-driven customer-interview platform used by Microsoft and Google, for about $2 billion, as it expands Agentforce with a fourth AI acquisition of 2026.
popularity_basis: Originally reported by Business Insider and corroborated by TechCrunch and PYMNTS; notable for Salesforce's aggressive AI-driven M&A pace.
